issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory with exist_ok=False could fail if another process creat
fix_summary: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in _ensure_parent_directory to handle TOCTOU race condition where another process might create the directory between the exists() check and mkdir() call.

risks.description: Using exist_ok=True means we no longer detect if the directory was created by another process after our check
risks.mitigation: This is actually the desired behavior for idempotent directory creation - the goal is to ensure the directory exists, not to guarantee we created it

validation_steps: Added regression test test_ensure_parent_directory_race_condition that simulates TOCTOU race condition
Ran ruff linting - all checks passed
